title: Craig Jones sends an NFLPA parting shot via email

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Craig Jones sends an NFLPA parting shot via email
sources.description: On Friday, the NFL Players Association fired long-time security officer Craig Jones, whose eloquent email challenging the state of union leadership emerged last year, during the quickly-unfolding turmoil that resulted in the abrupt resignation of NFLPA executive director Lloyd Howell.
